result.question: What happened to the seven sons of Sceva?

readings.answer: They were attacked and overpowered by the possessed man and fled the house naked and wounded.
readings.support: the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all | they ran out of the house naked and wounded

assessments.reason: Matches the passage’s wording: “the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all… they ran out of the house naked and wounded,” which is exactly what the key states happened to them.

result.reason: The passage explicitly says the possessed man overpowered them and they fled naked and wounded, matching the key.
